scenario.topic: Decide which songs should open and close the choir's spring concert

options.name: Joyful Morning Overture
options.upside: Sets an energetic and positive tone to start the concert.
options.concern: May be too familiar to some audience members.

options.name: Serene Twilight Hymn
options.upside: Provides a peaceful and reflective closing piece.
options.concern: Might feel too subdued as a concert finale.

options.name: Vibrant Spring Dance
options.upside: Offers a lively and challenging opening to engage singers and audience.
options.concern: Requires more rehearsal time due to complexity.

options.name: Peaceful Evening Lullaby
options.upside: Creates a gentle and intimate closing atmosphere.
options.concern: Short duration may leave the concert ending feeling abrupt.

shared_context: The choir will perform a spring concert featuring six songs. The group must select which songs will open and close the concert from four candidate pieces, considering length, difficulty, and mood to create a balanced program.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a music teacher passionate about creating reflective concert experiences.
personas.private_goal: Select a closing song that leaves the audience calm and thoughtful.

A.reason_for: Sets an energetic tone that contrasts well with a calm ending.
A.reason_against: May be too familiar and less unique for the concert opener.

B.reason_for: Provides a peaceful and reflective closing piece, ideal for ending the concert gently.

C.reason_for: Energetic and engaging for an opener.
C.reason_against: High difficulty may stress singers and detract from overall balance.

D.reason_against: Short length may make the ending feel abrupt.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a pragmatic choir member focused on smooth concert flow and simplicity.
personas.private_goal: Choose songs that are easy to perform and create a clear start and finish.

A.reason_for: Energetic opener that sets a positive mood.
A.reason_against: Familiarity might bore some audience members.

B.reason_for: Peaceful and easy closing piece, suitable for a calm finale.
B.reason_against: Could feel too subdued as a concert end.

C.reason_against: Too difficult and time-consuming to rehearse.

D.reason_for: Short, easy, and soothing closing song that feels intimate.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a choir conductor who values audience engagement and musical challenge.
personas.private_goal: Open with a dynamic piece that excites both singers and listeners.

D.reason_against: Too short and may feel abrupt.

personas.name: Eli

personas.private_goal: Start the concert with a challenging piece to showcase choir skill.

D.reason_against: Too short and may feel abrupt.

personas.name: Zara
personas.background: Zara is a choir member who enjoys expressive and calm musical moments.
personas.private_goal: End the concert with a peaceful and soothing piece to leave a lasting impression.

A.reason_for: Sets a positive tone at the start.
A.reason_against: May be too familiar and less expressive.
